request.style: English, Americana folk, weathered male vocal with female harmony, acoustic guitar, banjo, pedal steel, upright bass, soft kick drum, journeying feel, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He was seventy-five with his roots in the ground
His fathers' graves were all around
Then a voice came through the evening air
And it called him out to who knows where

[Chorus]
Leave your land, your kindred, and your father's house
And go to the land I will show you
I will make you into a great nation
And in you all the families of the earth will be blessed

[Verse]
Sarah packed the tent and the cooking pot
Lot drove the flocks from the family plot
No map to follow, no road to see
Just a promise and a God he could not see

[Chorus]
Leave your land, your kindred, and your father's house
And go to the land I will show you
I will make you into a great nation
And in you all the families of the earth will be blessed

[Bridge]
So Abram went, as the LORD had told him
So Abram went, not knowing where
So Abram went, as the LORD had told him
And the promise walked beside him there

[Outro]
And you will be a blessing
You will be a blessing
